rationale.selected_because: The objective is to establish what work the landlord reports completing and whether the smoke-alarm and socket issues are now addressed. The latest emails add a general completion claim and specific reports of work on two sockets, but do not establish the smoke-alarm work or whether all reported loose sockets were covered. Seek the relevant details from both landlord and tenant, communicate progress, and place the affected requests into completion review. The reports remain attributed reports, not independently verified facts.
